events.title: MTV Turns 45
events.blurb: MTV launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago, a channel launched that changed music forever. MTV arrived, and the first video they played was a statement: The Buggles with 'Video Killed The Radio Star.' Did video really kill the radio star, or just make them bigger?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped their debut 'Definitely Maybe'. That album defined a generation and launched them into superstardom. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival turns 57
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15 to 18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Remembering Woodstock
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, hundreds of thousands gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. A true cultural phenomenon.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42, at his Graceland estate.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: On this day in 1977, the world lost the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley. His music and legend live on.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Rapper Tupac Shakur was shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas, and tragically died six days later on September 13.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur today. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable, a voice that still resonates.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Guitar legend Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Today we remember the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, a true innovator whose guitar wizardry changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, in the UK.

angles.name: Abbey Road Anniversary
angles.copy: The iconic 'Abbey Road' from The Beatles is 57 years old. That album cover alone is legendary. What's your top track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Sending happy birthday wishes to the incredible Chrissie Hynde, turning 75 today! A true rock icon.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, former lead singer of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis track he sang?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' on October 11, 1971, in the US and October 24, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine's Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A timeless anthem for peace and hope that still resonates deeply today.

events.title: The original iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod changed how we listened to music forever. It's 25 years old this month – what was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Happy James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. It's James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007's enduring style, gadgets, and unforgettable theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor and comedian John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true British comedy legend.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What's your go-to track from it?
